note: PRELIMINARY — model selection revised after smoke test; see model_decision below

hardware.nand_note: Internal SSD; Ollama can memory-map models larger than RAM via NVMe paging

ollama.api_note: All experiment code uses REST API /api/generate with think=false. CLI 'ollama run' triggers unbounded extended thinking on qwen3.6 (confirmed: 2+ hours, no output).

model_decision.problem: qwen3.6 (23GB) exceeds 16GB unified memory. Generation rate 0.23 tok/s (4.26s/token) — heavy NVMe swap. At this rate: 47 test queries × ~100 tok/answer ≈ 5.6h per LLM system. Unacceptable for 4 LLM systems (S2, S3, S5, S6) + 30-run latency measurements.
model_decision.recommendation: Pull qwen2.5:7b-instruct (~4.7GB, fits entirely in 16GB RAM, expected ~25-35 tok/s). Keep qwen3.6 result in metadata as a data point but do not use it for experiments.
model_decision.status: AWAITING USER CONFIRMATION before pulling new models

cost.note: All inference local. Report tokens, latency, hardware instead of cost.
